title: Topic: dolo 365 medicine side effects
description:
@DrNikhilMD Colchicine is primarily used to treat and prevent gout flares and manage Familial Mediterranean Fever (FMF). It is also approved to reduce cardiovascular risks, such as heart attacks and strokes, in patients with atherosclerosis. By decreasing inflammation, it treats conditions like recurrent pericarditis and certain dermatological diseases.

Common Side Effects

Gastrointestinal: 
Diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain/cramping.Other: Fatigue, headache, and decreased appetite.

Serious Side Effects 
Muscle Problems: 
Unusual weakness, fatigue, muscle pain, or dark yellow/brown urine (signs of rhabdomyolysis).
Nerve Damage: 
Tingling or numbness in hands or feet.
Blood Disorders:
 Increased risk of infection (fever, sore throat), fatigue, or unusual bleeding/bruising.
Severe Gastrointestinal Distress:
 Bloody or black, tarry stools.
Allergic Reactions:
 Rash, itching, hives, or swelling of the face/lips/throat.
Toxicity: Colchicine has a narrow therapeutic range, meaning the dose that helps is close to the dose that is toxic
